parent_objective: design fresh broad scenario sampling for terminal-boundary source mining
supersedes: m695 source rows limited to M692 replay surface

public_gates: design samples fresh scenarios rather than only M692 rows
design includes normal-history prepass and normal-failed rejection
design includes terminal-margin and risk sensitivity tests
design includes source-diversity and heldout rules
design blocks objective actor update PPO and promotion
forbidden_shortcuts: do not reuse M692 rows as the only source
do not accept already normal-failed rows as action-critical

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_source: fresh scenario sampling for terminal-margin-sensitive rows
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a fresh scenario sampler after M695 showed inherited M692 rows are empty
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: sampling design only, not mining result, objective training, PPO, or promotion
stop_condition: stop if design still depends only on M692 replay rows
stop if design omits normal-failed rejection
stop before objective design until fresh mining produces accepted rows
fallback_plan: if fresh sampling is still empty, audit whether base actor is too weak or perturbation grid is too local
if fresh sampling is normal-failed-only, pivot to base capability improvement
if fresh sampling is trajectory-sensitive but history-insensitive, split base capability from self-ID claims
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: after fresh sampler implementation and audit, or earlier if accepted rows remain zero

hypothesis: Fresh broad scenario sampling can find terminal-margin-sensitive rows that the M692 replay surface missed.
success_criteria: design defines fresh seed and scenario sampling
design defines wrong/counterfactual-history tests when available
design defines source-diversity and split rules
objective actor update PPO and promotion remain blocked
failure_criteria: design accepts normal-failed rows as action-critical
design omits terminal-margin or risk sensitivity
design omits diversity and heldout rules
design admits objective training before mining
decision_rule: M697 is design-only and passes if it defines fresh terminal-boundary sampling with actor update PPO and promotion blocked.
